sources.ndmi: MODIS/061/MYD09A1 (sur_refl_b02/b06 normalised difference; StateQA bits 0-1 == 0 = not cloudy; bit layout verified identical to MOD09A1)
sources.aerosol: MODIS/061/MYD09A1 StateQA bits 6-7 = aerosol quantity (0 = climatology, 1 = low, 2 = average, 3 = high; layout verified identical to MOD09A1); aerosol_high_share = land-mean monthly frequency at level 3, aerosol_climatology_share = at level 0
sources.ndvi: MODIS/061/MYD13A1 (NDVI band, scale 1e-4; SummaryQA <= 1 = good pixel)
sources.geometry: MODIS/061/MYD13A1 ViewZenith and SolarZenith, stored in hundredths of a degree (scale 0.01); land means in degrees
sources.months: own month list, from MYD09A1's first month to the last month both Aqua products hold complete
sources.reduction: 500 m, monthly mean of composites, bestEffort=True, same as tasks 11-12
